name: Test vfox.rs

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'crates/vfox/**'
      - '.github/workflows/test-vfox.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'crates/vfox/**'
      - '.github/workflows/test-vfox.yml'

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        toolchain: [stable, beta, nightly]
        exclude:
          - os: macos-latest
            toolchain: beta
          - os: macos-latest
            toolchain: nightly

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        cache: true

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cd crates/vfox
        cargo test --workspace --all-features

    - name: Run tests without default features
      run: |
        cd crates/vfox
        cargo test --workspace --no-default-features

    - name: Run tests with specific features
      run: |
        cd crates/vfox
        cargo test --workspace --features "tokio,serde"

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        components: clippy, rustfmt

    - name: Run clippy
      run: |
        cd crates/vfox
        cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -- -D warnings

    - name: Check formatting
      run: |
        cd crates/vfox
        cargo fmt --check

  typos:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Check for typos
      uses: crate-ci/typos@master
      with:
        files: crates/vfox

  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        components: llvm-tools-preview

    - name: Install cargo-tarpaulin
      uses: baptiste0928/cargo-install@v3
      with:
        crate: cargo-tarpaulin
        version: "0.27.0"

    - name: Generate coverage report
      run: |
        cd crates/vfox
        cargo tarpaulin --workspace --all-features --out Xml

    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        directory: ./target/tarpaulin.xml
        flags: vfox
